retry_policy.name: Bounded k=2 retry policy (this engagement's standing rule)
retry_policy.rule: On a REJECTED verdict from the Review sub-task's 14-point checklist (or, for DASH-STORY-026-QA, on a failing run of the 14-case matrix against DEV's shipped code), exactly one retry of the failing sub-task is authorized: the failing sub-task's own dev_prompt/qa_prompt is re-dispatched to the same assigned agent with the specific FAIL findings appended as additional binding context (what failed, which AC/must-not-deviate item, the evidence citation). If the retry's own re-review is REJECTED a second time, the story STOPS and escalates to the user rather than attempting a third retry -- no unbounded retry loop is authorized under this policy.
retry_policy.count_semantics: k=2 means at most 2 total attempts at the failing sub-task (the original dispatch + 1 retry), not 2 retries after the original. A REJECTED verdict on attempt 2 is the escalation trigger.
retry_policy.escalation_target: user (Piyush Makhija), per this engagement's standing rule -- the same escalation posture Sprint 1-3's own p1_security_override and open_user_decisions blocks already route unresolved gates to.

DASH-STORY-026-REVIEW is the checker, not itself subject to this retry policy -- a Review sub-task does not retry itself; it either reaches a verdict or is itself escalated if the reviewing agent reports insufficient context per its own agent.md posture
retry_policy.logging_requirement: Each retry attempt, if it occurs in a future Phase B dispatch, must be logged with an attempt counter (1 of 2, 2 of 2) and the specific FAIL findings that triggered it, so the escalation to the user (if reached) carries the full attempt history rather than only the final failure.

determinism_guardrail.policy: Fixed low temperature for all dispatched CoT prompts (dev/qa/review), to bound run-to-run variance in generated code/tests/review verdicts. Reused verbatim from sprint3_implementation_execution_plan.json's guardrail (itself carried from Sprint 1/2) -- not re-derived.
determinism_guardrail.rationale: Code generation and structured verdicts (REVIEW OUTPUT PASS/FAIL) benefit from low-variance sampling; temperature=0.0 is the provider-level determinism setting used here rather than a fixed seed, since seed-level reproducibility is not guaranteed across model versions/providers -- temperature is the guardrail actually enforceable at dispatch time. This applies identically to a retry attempt under this file's retry_policy: the retry re-dispatch uses the same temperature=0.0 setting, not a higher-temperature exploratory pass.
determinism_guardrail.applies_to: Every dev_prompt, qa_prompt, and review_prompt entry above carries its own 'temperature' field set to this value, alongside its existing 'model' field.
determinism_guardrail.distinct_from: This is unrelated to the QA prompt's own 'fixture seed' instruction (test-data reproducibility) -- that governs test inputs, this governs LLM sampling.
